overview.description: The Baron Emerging Markets Select ETF (BCEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through exposure to stocks of any market capitalization from emerging markets. Security selection focuses on those with competitive advantages. BCEM was launched on Apr 8, 2026 and is issued by Baron.
